editorialNarrative.formCopy: South Africa have replaced Tristan Stubbs with Matthew Breetzke in their squad and assigned Ryan Rickelton the gloves. A team can reward a batter's comfort in a role, or keep moving its pieces to meet the next conditions. McDonald remains open-minded; Steve Waugh has publicly argued for continuity. That disagreement gives Australian supporters something more tangible than a selection slogan to watch. South Africa's altered roles put a similar question to their own dressing room: can a change of responsibilities create a more dependable batting unit?
